name: tiro-scribe-api-generator
description: Isolated toolchain for `pnpm generate:api`. @hey-api/openapi-ts drives the TypeScript compiler API (SyntaxKind, NewLineKind...), which the project-wide typescript@7 (native compiler) no longer ships — so the generator pins the exact TS it declares (6.0.3) in its own node_modules, kept out of the workspace hoisted layout.
